fullText.simplified:
十七、起死回生

    在南海仙山，白素贞拿出了一个药瓶。
    南极仙翁的两个神仙弟子一看，觉得奇怪极了。女神仙问：“这是仙翁的神瓶，不久前不见了。我们找了很久都没有找到，怎么在你那里？”
    白素贞说：“我是从一只黑羊妖那里得到的。那只黑羊妖拿着这个瓶子在人间害人，仙翁不知道吗？”
    “黑羊妖？”女神仙的脸色变了。
    “你想怎么样？”男神仙问。
    “我想把这个药瓶还给仙翁，也请仙翁救救我相公。”
    “你——大胆！”男神仙身后出现一道光，就要向白素贞劈去。
    “等等！”女神仙叫住他，然后望向天空，过了一会儿，她说：“仙翁刚刚说，你肚子里的孩子以后是个对人间大有帮助的人，他愿意帮助这个孩子的父亲。”
    “谢谢！”白素贞激动地哭着倒在地上，“谢谢仙翁！”
    女神仙飞到她面前，送给她一个小瓶子，说：“里面的药可以让死人活过来，你拿回去给许仙吃吧。神瓶和黑羊妖的事情不要对别人说。”
    “素贞明白！谢谢仙翁送药！”白素贞接了药，把神瓶还给了女神仙。
    女神仙看了看神瓶，点点头，然后和男神仙一起不见了。
    白素贞拿着药，回到了人间的家里。许仙还在床上，他的脸色已全白。白素贞连忙把药放进他嘴里，然后倒了些水，让他把药吃了。
    过了一会后，许仙的脸色变红了，他醒了过来。
    他看到了一脸关心的白素贞，问：“夫人，你怎么了？我这是在哪儿？”说完，他突然跳下床，着急地说：“夫人，我们房间里有蛇！一条好大好大的白蛇！快走！我们不能在这儿！”
    白素贞说：“没有蛇。你一直在睡觉，我也一直在这儿，你一定是喝多了，看错了。”
    “啊？没有蛇？你一直在这儿？”许仙看了看桌上的酒和菜，还有点儿想不明白，“夫人，你真的没有看到蛇？”
    “没有。”白素贞说。
    “啊！看来我真的喝多了，这雄黄酒太厉害了，以后不能喝了。”
    “对，以后不能喝雄黄酒了。”
    许仙看到白素贞的眼睛红红的，吃惊地问：“夫人，你哭了？怎么了？”
    “没什么，我就是高兴，为我们的孩子高兴，听说他以后能帮很多人。”
    “真的吗？你听谁说的？”
    “我听神仙说的。”
    许仙笑了，说：“夫人，我看你才喝多了呢！你怎么会遇到神仙？”
    白素贞笑着不说话。她高兴极了，也累极了。
    事情终于过去了，还好许仙没事，还好他不知道自己是妖。
fullText.traditional:
十七、起死回生

    在南海仙山，白素貞拿出了一個藥瓶。
    南極仙翁的兩個神仙弟子一看，覺得奇怪極了。女神仙問：“這是仙翁的神瓶，不久前不見了。我們找了很久都沒有找到，怎麼在你那裡？”
    白素貞說：“我是從一隻黑羊妖那裡得到的。那隻黑羊妖拿著這個瓶子在人間害人，仙翁不知道嗎？”
    “黑羊妖？”女神仙的臉色變了。
    “你想怎麼樣？”男神仙問。
    “我想把這個藥瓶還給仙翁，也請仙翁救救我相公。”
    “你——大膽！”男神仙身後出現一道光，就要向白素貞劈去。
    “等等！”女神仙叫住他，然後望向天空，過了一會兒，她說：“仙翁剛剛說，你肚子裡的孩子以後是個對人間大有幫助的人，他願意幫助這個孩子的父親。”
    “謝謝！”白素貞激動地哭著倒在地上，“謝謝仙翁！”
    女神仙飛到她面前，送給她一個小瓶子，說：“裡面的藥可以讓死人活過來，你拿回去給許仙吃吧。神瓶和黑羊妖的事情不要對別人說。”
    “素貞明白！謝謝仙翁送藥！”白素貞接了藥，把神瓶還給了女神仙。
    女神仙看了看神瓶，點點頭，然後和男神仙一起不見了。
    白素貞拿著藥，回到了人間的家裡。許仙還在床上，他的臉色已全白。白素貞連忙把藥放進他嘴裡，然後倒了些水，讓他把藥吃了。
    過了一會後，許仙的臉色變紅了，他醒了過來。
    他看到了一臉關心的白素貞，問：“夫人，你怎麼了？我這是在哪兒？”說完，他突然跳下床，著急地說：“夫人，我們房間裡有蛇！一條好大好大的白蛇！快走！我們不能在這兒！”
    白素貞說：“沒有蛇。你一直在睡覺，我也一直在這兒，你一定是喝多了，看錯了。”
    “啊？沒有蛇？你一直在這兒？”許仙看了看桌上的酒和菜，還有點兒想不明白，“夫人，你真的沒有看到蛇？”
    “沒有。”白素貞說。
    “啊！看來我真的喝多了，這雄黃酒太厲害了，以後不能喝了。”
    “對，以後不能喝雄黃酒了。”
    許仙看到白素貞的眼睛紅紅的，吃驚地問：“夫人，你哭了？怎麼了？”
    “沒什麼，我就是高興，為我們的孩子高興，聽說他以後能幫很多人。”
    “真的嗎？你聽誰說的？”
    “我聽神仙說的。”
    許仙笑了，說：“夫人，我看你才喝多了呢！你怎麼會遇到神仙？”
    白素貞笑著不說話。她高興極了，也累極了。
    事情終於過去了，還好許仙沒事，還好他不知道自己是妖。

sentences.pinyin: wǒ tīng shén xiān shuō de
sentences.english: “I heard it from an immortal.”

sentences.simplified: 许仙笑了，说：“夫人，我看你才喝多了呢！你怎么会遇到神仙？”
sentences.traditional: 許仙笑了，說：“夫人，我看你才喝多了呢！你怎麼會遇到神仙？”
sentences.pinyin: xǔ xiān xiào le shuō fū rén wǒ kàn nǐ cái hē duō le ne nǐ zěn me huì yù dào shén xiān
sentences.english: Xu Xian smiled and said, “My wife, I think you’re the one who’s had too much to drink! How would you have encountered an immortal?”

sentences.simplified: 白素贞笑着不说话。她高兴极了，也累极了。
sentences.traditional: 白素貞笑著不說話。她高興極了，也累極了。
sentences.pinyin: bái sù zhēn xiào zhe bù shuō huà tā gāo xìng jí le yě lèi jí le
sentences.english: Bai Suzhen smiled and didn’t speak. She was extremely happy, but also extremely tired.

sentences.simplified: 事情终于过去了，还好许仙没事，还好他不知道自己是妖。
sentences.traditional: 事情終於過去了，還好許仙沒事，還好他不知道自己是妖。
sentences.pinyin: shì qing zhōng yú guò qù le hái hǎo xǔ xiān méi shì hái hǎo tā bù zhī dào zì jǐ shì yāo
sentences.english: It was finally over. Fortunately, Xu Xian was fine, and fortunately, he didn’t know that she was a demon.

sentence_translations: 17. Bringing the Dead Back to Life
At the Nanhai immortal mountain, Bai Suzhen took out a medicine bottle.
The two immortal disciples of the Old Immortal of the South Pole looked at it and found it very strange.
The female immortal asked, “This is the Old Immortal’s divine bottle, which went missing not long ago.
We searched for a long time and couldn’t find it. How did it end up with you?”
Bai Suzhen said, “I got it from a black sheep demon.
That black sheep demon was using this bottle to harm people in the human world. The Old Immortal doesn’t know about this?”
“Black sheep demon?” The female immortal’s expression changed.
“What do you want?” the male immortal asked.
“I want to return this medicine bottle to the Old Immortal, and also to ask the Old Immortal to save my husband.”
“You—the audacity!” A beam of light appeared behind the male immortal, ready to strike Bai Suzhen.
“Wait!” The female immortal stopped him, then looked up at the sky.
After a while, she said, ..
.. “The Old Immortal just said that the child in your womb will be someone who greatly benefits the human world in the future.
He is willing to help this child’s father.”
“Thank you!” Bai Suzhen fell to the ground, crying with emotion, “Thank you, Old Immortal!”
The female immortal flew in front of her and gave her a small bottle.
She said, “The medicine inside can bring the dead back to life. Take it back and give it to Xu Xian.
Don’t tell anyone about the divine bottle and the black sheep demon.”
“I understand! Thank you, Old Immortal, for giving me the medicine!”
Bai Suzhen took the medicine and returned the divine bottle to the female immortal.
The female immortal looked at the divine bottle, nodded, and then disappeared together with the male immortal.
Bai Suzhen took the medicine and returned to her home in the human world.
Xu Xian was still on the bed. His face was already completely pale.
Bai Suzhen hurriedly put the medicine into his mouth, then poured some water to help him take the medicine.
After a while, Xu Xian’s complexion turned red, and he woke up.
Seeing Bai Suzhen’s concerned expression, he asked, “My wife, what happened? Where am I?”
After speaking, he suddenly jumped out of the bed and said anxiously, ..
.. “My wife, there’s a snake in our room! A very, very large white snake! Quick, we must leave! We can’t stay here!”
Bai Suzhen said, “There is no snake.
You’ve been sleeping this whole time, and I have also been here this whole time.
You must have had too much to drink and got it wrong.”
“Huh? No snake? You’ve been here this whole time?”
Xu Xian looked at the wine and dishes on the table, and was still a bit confused.
“My wife, you really didn’t see the snake?”
“No,” Bai Suzhen said.
“Ah! Seems like I really had too much to drink. This realgar wine is too strong, I shouldn’t drink it anymore.”
“Yes, we can’t drink realgar wine anymore.”
Xu Xian saw that Bai Suzhen’s eyes were red and asked in surprise, “My wife, have you been crying? What’s wrong?”
“Nothing, I’m just happy, happy for our child. I heard that he will be able to help many people in the future.”
“Really? Who did you hear that from?”
“I heard it from an immortal.”
Xu Xian smiled and said, “My wife, I think you’re the one who’s had too much to drink! How would you have encountered an immortal?”
Bai Suzhen smiled and didn’t speak. She was extremely happy, but also extremely tired.
It was finally over. Fortunately, Xu Xian was fine, and fortunately, he didn’t know that she was a demon.
